modules.mathematical_scope: On a finite native comparison tube scaled by its complete denominator coprime to three, a terminal zero forces every preceding comparison and every integer forcing in [-2,2] to vanish. No cyclic closure, transitivity, spatial ordering or denominator-size premise is used. Construction of the actual binary tube, prime dilation, entropy and asymptotic band-exit applications remain written.
